mentions.name: Non-interactive LFS/BLFS build scripts
mentions.description: This project provides scripts for compiling software from source, with the goal of building a complete LFS/BLFS (Linux from Scratch/Beyond Linux from Scratch) system fully non-interactively, using actionable scripts at every moment and git sources rather than old releases.
mentions.problem: Existing automated solutions like AFLS have formats and restrictions that don't suit the author's workflow, and interactive LFS/BLFS builds are impractical.
mentions.source_excerpt: improvements to the scripts I use to compile software from source; I want to be able to build a complete LFS/BLFS without any interaction (I know there is AFLS but I don't like the format or restrictions; I literally want to be able to do everything here via actionable scripts at every moment in time, including using git sources rather than old releases)
